name: StG 44

sights.note: measured on the supplied mesh after bake (rot -7.3 deg levels the sight line, roll -12.77 deg removes the 12.8 deg cant the GLB carries about the bore): rear = shoulder line over the 2 mm U-notch of the tangent leaf (notch bottom y 0.16145), front = pointed post tip inside the hood (hood top y 0.1726); the supplied mesh is yawed 1.45 deg about y (bore and sight line agree), which ADS absorbs

note: Sturmgewehr 44 (1944 assault rifle, intermediate 7.92x33 Kurz, 30-round box, selector). Sandbox / later-war: hidden by the strict 6 June 1944 preset. Preset: 30 + 5 magazines (tuning).

animated.hideNote: SG1: the charging handle as supplied is a ~15 cm rod sticking out right of the receiver (the rig file's Slide part): hidden until the rig is fixed (the user: hide it)

points.note: SG1: measured on the rig from the game's ADS eye (E:/nmk/swat_tools xbsolve.py + stgfit.py: the GLB's rest->idle delta, relief 0.18, narrow renders clipped to each sight; three rounds): rear = the tangent leaf's U-notch centre on its shoulder line (notch 1.5 mm wide, 3.6 mm deep on this rifle), front = the post tip inside its hood; up levels the leaf (the rig's view rolled it 1.2 deg). Emulated ADS: notch and tip within 0.5 px of the centre, leaf level

animated.note: SG1: the user's first-person arms rig (STG44_fps_arms.glb: the SCAR-H fps arms, the StG's parts on the Weapon / Magazine / Slide bones; local-only models/stg44_rig_local, git-ignored: the arms' licence is unknown). Without it, or with perf stg44rig off, the static StG with the generated arm. Clips from one 24 fps timeline: idle 49-80, fire 80-89 (one shot: the rifle kicks 2.5 cm, the bolt cycles; at 3.5x each round at 560 rpm), reload 101-172 and reload_empty 173-281 (the handle pulled and held, the magazine, the handle released) at 1.1x: 2.69 / 4.09 s; the draw 1-48 and a second shot 92-100 not played. The hands keep the SCAR rig's grip positions (finger contact close, not exact)
